changes.name: SkyboundPetSystem
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local map=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap")

local old=map:FindFirstChild("GrasslandsEgg")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local stand=Instance.new("Part")
stand.Name="GrasslandsEgg"
stand.Size=Vector3.new(8,2,8)
stand.Position=Vector3.new(0,61,25)
stand.Anchored=true
stand.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
stand.Color=Color3.fromRGB(235,235,255)
stand.Parent=map

local egg=Instance.new("Part")
egg.Name="Egg"
egg.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
egg.Size=Vector3.new(5,7,5)
egg.Position=Vector3.new(0,65,25)
egg.Anchored=true
egg.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
egg.Color=Color3.fromRGB(125,220,255)
egg.Parent=stand

local light=Instance.new("PointLight")
light.Color=Color3.fromRGB(100,210,255)
light.Brightness=2
light.Range=14
light.Parent=egg

local prompt=Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText="HATCH - 10 SKY COINS"
prompt.ObjectText="GRASSLANDS EGG"
prompt.HoldDuration=.3
prompt.MaxActivationDistance=10
prompt.RequiresLineOfSight=false
prompt.Parent=egg

local gui=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
gui.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(300,100)
gui.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,5,0)
gui.AlwaysOnTop=true
gui.Parent=egg

local text=Instance.new("TextLabel")
text.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
text.BackgroundTransparency=1
text.Text="GRASSLANDS EGG\n10 SKY COINS"
text.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
text.TextStrokeTransparency=.25
text.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
text.TextScaled=true
text.Parent=gui

local pets={
 {name="Cloud Bunny",weight=55,color=Color3.fromRGB(235,245,255)},
 {name="Sky Fox",weight=30,color=Color3.fromRGB(110,210,255)},
 {name="Sun Cub",weight=12,color=Color3.fromRGB(255,205,70)},
 {name="Storm Dragon",weight=3,color=Color3.fromRGB(145,95,255)}
}

local function ensurePets(player)
 local folder=player:FindFirstChild("Pets")
 if not folder then
  folder=Instance.new("Folder")
  folder.Name="Pets"
  folder.Parent=player
 end
 return folder
end

local function rollPet()
 local roll=math.random(1,100)
 local total=0
 for _,pet in ipairs(pets) do
  total+=pet.weight
  if roll<=total then return pet end
 end
 return pets[1]
end

local function makeFollower(player,pet)
 local character=player.Character
 local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not root then return end

 local model=Instance.new("Part")
 model.Name=player.Name.."_Pet"
 model.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
 model.Size=Vector3.new(3,3,3)
 model.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
 model.Color=pet.color
 model.CanCollide=false
 model.Massless=true
 model.CFrame=root.CFrame*CFrame.new(4,1,3)
 model.Parent=workspace

 local face=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
 face.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(150,45)
 face.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,2.5,0)
 face.AlwaysOnTop=true
 face.Parent=model
 local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
 label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
 label.BackgroundTransparency=1
 label.Text=pet.name
 label.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
 label.TextStrokeTransparency=.25
 label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
 label.TextScaled=true
 label.Parent=face

 local attachment0=Instance.new("Attachment")
 attachment0.Parent=root
 attachment0.Position=Vector3.new(4,1,3)
 local attachment1=Instance.new("Attachment")
 attachment1.Parent=model
 local align=Instance.new("AlignPosition")
 align.Attachment0=attachment1
 align.Attachment1=attachment0
 align.MaxForce=50000
 align.Responsiveness=18
 align.Parent=model
end

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
 local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
 local coins=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins")
 if not coins or coins.Value<10 then return end
 coins.Value-=10
 local pet=rollPet()
 local folder=ensurePets(player)
 local owned=Instance.new("StringValue")
 owned.Name=pet.name
 owned.Value=pet.name
 owned.Parent=folder

 local existing=workspace:FindFirstChild(player.Name.."_Pet")
 if existing then existing:Destroy() end
 makeFollower(player,pet)
 prompt.ObjectText="HATCHED: "..pet.name
 task.delay(2,function()
  if prompt.Parent then prompt.ObjectText="GRASSLANDS EGG" end
 end)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
 local pet=workspace:FindFirstChild(player.Name.."_Pet")
 if pet then pet:Destroy() end
end)

print("Skybound Grasslands Egg loaded")
